summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, an obfuscated Node script using hex-mangled identifiers (e.g. `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/` into a temporary directory and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` against a bundled ~727 KB sibling file `math_init.js`. That sibling file is a Bun-CJS bundle (starts with `// @bun @bun-cjs`) built as an obfuscator.io-style hex/number string-array with a shuffler function, so its runtime behavior is opaque to Node-based tooling. The declared purpose of the package is a shared React repo configuration (ESLint/Prettier/svgo/cross-env), which has no legitimate need to pull a second language runtime at install time and hand it an obfuscated executable payload. Package name and metadata mimic the @ornikar shared-configs family, whose prior versions ship plain configuration files with no preinstall hook, no Bun download, and no bundled binary payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
